source: City of Walnut Creek Municipal Code Ch. 10-2 (https://www.codepublishing.com/CA/WalnutCreek/html/WalnutCreek10/WalnutCreek1002A.html); Walnut Creek General Plan 2025 (https://www.walnutcreekca.gov/government/community-development-department/zoning/long-range-plans/general-plan); Single-Family Residential District Art. 1 (https://www.codepublishing.com/CA/WalnutCreek/html/WalnutCreek10/WalnutCreek1002B-01.html); Multi-Family Districts Art. 3 (https://www.codepublishing.com/CA/WalnutCreek/html/WalnutCreek10/WalnutCreek1002B-03.html); Zoning page (https://www.walnutcreekca.gov/government/community-development-department/zoning)

R-40.description: Single Family Residential, Very Low Density. 40,000 sq ft minimum lot. Up to ~1 du/ac.

R-20.description: Single Family Residential, Low Density. 20,000 sq ft minimum lot. Up to ~2.2 du/ac.

R-15.description: Single Family Residential, Low Density. 15,000 sq ft minimum lot. Up to 3.0 du/ac (SFL designation).

R-12.description: Single Family Residential, Low-Medium Density. 12,000 sq ft minimum lot.

R-10.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density. 10,000 sq ft minimum lot.

R-8.5.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density. 8,500 sq ft minimum lot.

R-8.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density. 8,000 sq ft minimum lot.

R-6.description: Single Family Residential, Medium-High Density. 6,000 sq ft minimum lot. SFM designation (3.1-6.0 du/ac).

D-3.description: Duplex/Triplex Residential District. Low-density multi-family. 6.1-14.0 du/ac (MFL designation).

M.description: Multiple Family Residential District. Apartments, condominiums. Multi-Family Low (MFL): 6.1-14.0 du/ac.

MFM.description: Multi-Family Medium Density (General Plan designation). 14.1-30.0 du/ac.

M-H-D.description: High Density Residential Planned Development District. Multi-Family Very High (MFVH): 30.1-50.0 du/ac.

H-P-D.description: Hillside Planned Development District. Open space/agriculture areas. Max 1 du/10 ac (0.1 du/ac); 1 du/20 ac in high-risk areas.

SFH-PD1.description: Single Family Hillside Planned Development 1. Hillside residential with moderate density.

P-D.description: Planned Development District. Density per approved development plan and underlying general plan designation.

CC.description: Core Area/City Center. Mixed-use, residential permitted above ground floor commercial. Density per specific plan.

C-N.description: Neighborhood Commercial District. Convenience retail and services.

C-R.description: Regional Commercial District. Large-scale retail and commercial.

O-P.description: Office Park District. Office and professional uses.

L-I.description: Light Industrial District. Light manufacturing, warehousing, and industrial uses.

AS-CM.description: Auto Service - Commercial Manufacturing District. Auto-oriented commercial and light manufacturing.

BP-100.description: Business Park District, 100% lot coverage. Office and business park uses.

BP-200.description: Business Park District, 200% lot coverage. Intensive office and business park uses.

CF.description: Community Facilities District. Public and institutional facilities.

CR.description: Regional Commercial District (alternate code for C-R). Large-scale retail and commercial.

HPD.description: Hillside Planned Development District (alternate code for H-P-D). Max 1 du/10 ac.

HPD-6.description: Hillside Planned Development District, 6 du/ac max. Hillside residential with moderate density.

M-0.75.description: Multiple Family Residential District, 0.75 FAR. Multi-family low density.

M-1.description: Multiple Family Residential District, 1.0 FAR. Multi-family low-medium density.

M-1.5.description: Multiple Family Residential District, 1.5 FAR. Multi-family medium density.

M-2.description: Multiple Family Residential District, 2.0 FAR. Multi-family medium-high density.

M-2.5.description: Multiple Family Residential District, 2.5 FAR. Multi-family high density.

MHD.description: Multi-Family High Density District. High density residential. 30.1-50 du/ac.

MUC.description: Mixed Use Commercial District. Mixed-use with commercial emphasis and residential permitted.

MUD.description: Mixed Use Downtown District. Mixed-use in downtown area with residential above commercial.

MUPD.description: Mixed Use Planned Development District. Mixed-use per approved development plan.

MUR.description: Mixed Use Residential District. Mixed-use with residential emphasis.

OC.description: Office Commercial District. Office and compatible commercial uses.

OSR.description: Open Space/Recreation District. Parks, recreation, and open space.

PD.description: Planned Development District (alternate code for P-D). Density per approved plan.

PR.description: Parks and Recreation District. Public parks and recreational facilities.

SC.description: Shopping Center District. Planned shopping center commercial uses.

UTIL.description: Utility District. Public utility facilities and infrastructure.
